likely_cause: Message processed successfully
next_action: No action

likely_cause: Receiver found a problem in the message content
next_action: Read the ERR segment and fix the source data, then resend

likely_cause: Receiver refused the message (type, version, processing id or system problem)
next_action: Check MSH-9, MSH-11 and MSH-12 against the receiver's spec

likely_cause: Enhanced-mode receipt: message stored
next_action: No action

likely_cause: Enhanced-mode receipt: message could not be stored
next_action: Check the receiver's storage and resend

likely_cause: Enhanced-mode receipt: message refused before storage
next_action: Check the header fields and resend

likely_cause: No error
next_action: No action

likely_cause: Segments out of order or a required segment missing
next_action: Compare segment order with the message structure

likely_cause: A field the receiver requires is empty
next_action: Find the empty field in ERR-2 and fix the source mapping

likely_cause: A value does not match the field's data type
next_action: Check the field format (dates, numbers, coded values)

likely_cause: A coded value is not in the receiver's table
next_action: Add or map the code in the translation table

likely_cause: A value exceeds the receiver's maximum length
next_action: Truncate or remap in the outbound transform

likely_cause: The receiver does not accept this message type
next_action: Confirm routing: this message should not go to this receiver

likely_cause: The receiver does not accept this trigger event
next_action: Filter the event out or request support from the receiver

likely_cause: MSH-11 is not what the receiver expects (e.g. test vs production)
next_action: Set the correct processing id for the environment

likely_cause: MSH-12 version is not accepted
next_action: Align the version with the receiver's spec

likely_cause: The record the message refers to does not exist at the receiver
next_action: Check whether the create message was sent first

likely_cause: The record already exists at the receiver
next_action: Check for a duplicate send; do not resend blindly

likely_cause: The receiver's record was in use
next_action: Retry after the lock clears

likely_cause: Unexpected error inside the receiving application
next_action: Open a ticket with the receiving application's team

likely_cause: Destination host or port not listening
next_action: Check the destination service and port, then restart the connection

likely_cause: Certificate or protocol mismatch
next_action: Check certificate validity and TLS versions on both ends

likely_cause: Missing start or end block characters
next_action: Check the sender's MLLP wrapper settings

likely_cause: No acknowledgement within the timeout
next_action: Check the receiver's health; messages queue until it responds

likely_cause: Outbound queue reached its limit
next_action: Escalate to the on-call owner; find why the destination is not consuming

likely_cause: Message exceeds the configured size limit
next_action: Check for embedded documents; route to the document channel

likely_cause: Unexpected characters for the declared encoding
next_action: Check MSH-18 and the source system's encoding

likely_cause: No filter or route accepted the message
next_action: Review routing filters for this message type

likely_cause: The mapping script failed on this message
next_action: Read the transform log and fix the script in test first

likely_cause: MSH-10 repeated within the duplicate window
next_action: Check the sender for resends before releasing

likely_cause: The destination connection is turned off
next_action: Confirm the change window before re-enabling

likely_cause: The connection certificate is past its end date
next_action: Renew and install the certificate

likely_cause: Delivery retries exhausted
next_action: Fix the cause, then release the held messages with approval
